theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the only eligible theme combining a durable trend (durability 0.77, hurst 'trend') with broad participation (breadth 0.769) and non-crowded positioning (crowding_z -0.20). Unlike the Gold leader, it is scorable via 512400.SS, so the direction is falsifiable. It sits mid-rank (4th) but shows healthier internal structure than the AI challenger. The lean is an expression that trend persistence within a commodity-linked group can hold for a few weeks even in a choppy tape, not a claim the rank predicts returns.
theses.dissent: Backtest verdict says the trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws trend followers; a broad but moderate score and mid-level rank may simply fade like most prior signals (track record dir_accuracy 0.318).
